equivalent_candidates.note: flow == cop_flow_reference_temp: carnot_flow == carnot_ref exactly, ratio 1.0, so both arms return 1.0; 24 cells over 4 parameter sets x 6 outdoor temps: 0 differences

The 1.0 K lift floor only binds when cop_reference_temp > flow_temp (the outdoor cap exceeds the flow); default params (7 C / 35 C) never reach it. Moves only with cop_reference_temp 40-50 C, which no config or option surface sets (no field in const.py/config_flow.py, no clamp)

carnot_ref <= 1e-9 needs cop_flow_reference_temp <= -273.15 C; for ref in -100..60 C (24 cells) both arms agree; the only divergences are at ref <= -273.15 C (ZeroDivisionError at -273.15, 0.25 at -300), below absolute zero and outside any physical configuration (6 of 24 cells move, all at ref -273.15 and -300)
